meta.title: Accessibility statement | Larch Street Library
meta.description: How well the library website works for everyone, and how to tell us about a problem.

body: We want everyone to be able to use this website. We aim to meet the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 at level AAA.
The site partially conforms to that standard. It meets level AA and most of level AAA.
Known limitations: some old event lists are scans of paper sheets. They are not yet accessible. We plan to replace them by June 2027.
If you find a problem, or need a page in another format, tell us. Email access@example.org and we will reply within five working days.
If you are not happy with our reply, you can complain to the equality body. This is the enforcement procedure.
This statement was prepared in November 2026, when we last tested the site.
